result_summary.title: Payment Gateway v2 showing declined payments and overcharges in US-West Staging
result_summary.description: We are seeing critical issues in our US-West staging environment with Payment Gateway v2. A large number of test cases are resulting in payment declines, while others are showing overcharges. It is unclear whether the issue lies within the gateway's transaction processing or the currency conversion logic applied during the payment step. The symptoms include both failed transactions and incorrect final amounts charged. Please help us determine if this is a gateway configuration issue or a conversion rate calculation error.
